atoms/brand-mark.description:
Generic brand-mark primitive. Renders a single SVG `path` either with
`currentColor` (the default) or with a two-stop linear gradient when both
`from` and `to` are provided. Sizing is controlled via `className`
(`h-10 w-auto`); the SVG honours its `viewBox` aspect ratio.

Apps consuming canvas typically build a thin wrapper around this component
that hard-codes their own brand path / gradient — see the docs site's
`OlympusLogo` for a worked example.

props.name: path
props.description:
SVG path data (`d` attribute) for the brand mark. Required — canvas
does not ship a default brand shape; consuming apps supply their own.

props.name: viewBox
props.description: SVG `viewBox` matching the path's coordinate space.

props.name: transform
props.description:
Optional inner `transform` applied to the path's `<g>` group — useful
when the path coordinates need to be translated, rotated, or scaled
relative to the viewBox.

props.name: from
props.description:
Gradient start colour. When omitted, the path is filled with
`currentColor` and no gradient is generated.

props.name: to
props.description: Gradient end colour. Required when `from` is set.

props.name: variant
props.description:
Visual emphasis preset. `default` is the primary action, `destructive`
is for irreversible actions, `outline` and `secondary` are quieter,
`ghost` is borderless, `link` looks like body-text underlined.

props.name: size
props.description:
Height + horizontal padding preset. `sm` is 32px, `default` is 36px,
`lg` is 40px, `icon` is square 36×36 for icon-only buttons (always
pair with `aria-label`).

props.name: asChild
props.description:
Render as a Radix Slot — forwards className and behaviour onto the
immediate child element instead of rendering a wrapper `<button>`.
Common pattern for using a router `<Link>` while keeping the Button
styling.

props.description: Tab order. Default behaviour is one of native `<button>` tab focus.

props.description: Accessible label, required for icon-only buttons (`size="icon"`).

props.name: aria-describedby
props.description: ID of an element that describes the button's purpose.

props.description: Tailwind gap step (0–6) or a raw CSS value.

props.description:

props.name: className
props.description: Tailwind / CSS classes merged onto the label via `cn()`.

atoms/logo.description: Brand-agnostic logo slot. - With no `src`: renders the default Olympus mark (gradient ring or sideways-O icon based on `variant`). The `icon` variant supports `showText` for the "○lympus" wordmark lockup. - With `src`: renders an `` so consumers can drop in their own brand. Sizing: the `size` prop maps to `width`/`height` for the `icon` and `src` paths; the `ring` path is sized via `className` (e.g. `className="h-10 w-auto"`) because its viewBox aspect ratio is non-square.

props.name: src
props.description: Custom logo image. When provided, renders an `` instead of the default Olympus mark. Apps consuming canvas pass their own brand here.

props.name: alt
props.description: Alt text for the custom-image variant. Required when `src` is set.

props.name: size
props.description: Pixel size for the icon variant and any custom `src` image. Default 24.

props.name: variant
props.description:
Default-mark variant (only consulted when `src` is not provided).
- `icon` (default): the small sideways-O ellipse rendered with `currentColor`.
- `ring`: the larger stadium/ring mark filled with the Olympus blue gradient.
  Best for header/decorative use ≥ 40px.

props.name: showText
props.description: When true and using the default `icon` variant, renders "○lympus" wordmark.

props.name: value

props.name: max
props.description:

`value / max * 100%`.

value to screen readers. Defaults to `"X%"`.

Source-code editor backed by CodeMirror 6. Pick a language with the
`language` prop; the wrapper loads the matching highlighter and applies
canvas-themed colours via `useCodemirrorTheme()`.

organisms/editors/markdown-editor.description:
Markdown editor backed by CodeMirror 6 with markdown syntax highlighting,
a canvas-styled toolbar, and an optional sanitized preview pane.

Controlled component. `value` is the markdown source string; `onChange`
fires on every doc change.

organisms/editors/rich-text-editor.description:
Rich text editor backed by Tiptap (ProseMirror). Ships with bold / italic /
strike / code / list / blockquote / code-block / link / heading levels.

Controlled component: `value` is an HTML string by default, or a JSON string
when `outputFormat="json"`. `onChange` fires on every doc update.

Layout chrome shared by every editor toolbar: a horizontal flex bar with
`--border` separator below, `--card` background tint, padding tuned for
canvas's button/icon size. Per-engine toolbars compose canvas atoms
(Button, Toggle, Icon, ToggleGroup) inside this shell.

Children are arranged with `gap-1` between groups; use `<ToolbarDivider />`
to insert a thin vertical separator between conceptual groups.

props.name: form
props.description:
ID of the form this button belongs to, when the button sits outside
the `<form>` element.

props.name: className
props.description: Tailwind / CSS classes merged onto the root element via `cn()`.

props.name: tabIndex
props.description: Tab order. Default behaviour is one of native `<button>` tab focus.

props.name: aria-describedby
props.description: ID of an element that describes the button's purpose.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible label, required for icon-only buttons (`size="icon"`).

props.name: children
props.description: Visible label or any nested elements (icons, badges).

props.name: onClick
props.description: Click handler. Receives a `MouseEvent<HTMLButtonElement>`.

props.name: variant
props.description:
Visual emphasis preset. `default` is the primary action, `destructive`
is for irreversible actions, `outline` and `secondary` are quieter,
`ghost` is borderless, `link` looks like body-text underlined.

props.name: disabled
props.description:
When true, dims the button to 50% opacity and blocks pointer/keyboard
input.

props.name: name
props.description: Form name when this button submits/resets a form (for forms with multiple buttons).

props.name: type
props.description:
Native HTML button type. `submit` triggers parent form submission;
`reset` resets parent form fields; `button` does neither.

props.name: value
props.description: Form value sent with the form when this button is the submitter.

props.name: asChild
props.description:
Render as a Radix Slot — forwards className and behaviour onto the
immediate child element instead of rendering a wrapper `<button>`.
Common pattern for using a router `<Link>` while keeping the Button
styling.

props.name: size
props.description:
Height + horizontal padding preset. `sm` is 32px, `default` is 36px,
`lg` is 40px, `icon` is square 36×36 for icon-only buttons (always
pair with `aria-label`).

props.name: storageKey
props.description: localStorage key. Default: `"olympus-theme"`.

props.name: disableTransitionOnChange
props.description: Skip DOM/storage side effects (useful for SSR/tests).

props.name: sidebar
props.type: ReactNode | ((ctx: { expanded: boolean; setExpanded: (v: boolean) => void; closeMobile: () => void; }) => ReactNode)
props.description:
Sidebar content. Rendered on md+ in a fixed left column and in an
overlay drawer on mobile.

props.name: header
props.description: Optional header rendered above the scrollable main area.

props.name: expandedSidebarClass
props.description: Width class for expanded sidebar. Default `"md:ml-60"` (60 × 0.25rem = 15rem).

props.name: collapsedSidebarClass
props.description: Width class for collapsed sidebar. Default `"md:ml-14"`.

props.name: brandHeader
props.description:
Brand header rendered above the card — typically your `<BrandMark>` or a
Logo wrapper plus the title/subtitle. Pass `null` to hide.

props.name: background
props.description: Optional decorative background (e.g. animated gradient, gradient slot).

props.name: footer
props.description: Optional footer text below the card.

props.name: cardWidthClass
props.description: Card width class. Default `"max-w-md"`.

props.name: steps
props.description: Step list shown in the left nav.

props.name: activeStep
props.description: Currently active step id.

props.name: sidebarHeader
props.description: Optional header content inside the sidebar (logo, app name).

props.name: sidebarFooter
props.description: Optional extra nav content below the step list (links, destroy button).

props.name: terminal
props.description:
Optional collapsible terminal panel shown at the bottom of the content
area. When provided, a toggle bar is rendered.

props.name: defaultTerminalOpen
props.description: Default terminal open state. Default `true`.

props.name: footer
props.description: Optional ActionBar slot pinned below main content.

props.name: shellClassName
props.description: Extra className for the outer flex row (e.g. "mcp-shimmer").
